rows.title: 10. 계단 끝에서
rows.displayed_style: Modern Korean R&B and neo-soul in A Major at an exact, unchanging 175 BPM, A clean electric guitar leads the clipped syncopated riff and answers the vocal, with round bass and a tight dry drum pocket, No Rhodes-centered part, One clear male solo chest-voice delivers precise Korean close and dry, without vocal reverb or room sound, Keep verses conversational; each chorus rises to a strong, lucid high chest-mix belt without doubles, Slightly laid-back phrases sit against the fixed beat, Let the guitar answer after the hook; target over three minutes, ‑Indie rock, ‑Rhodes lead, ‑distorted guitars, ‑airy vocals, ‑falsetto, ‑harmonies, ‑backing vocals, ‑vocal reverb
